playbook.intent: The sprint has closed and the same class of failure has turned up in the postmortems again, while the team's memory of what was agreed last time has already gone soft. It ends when three patterns each have an owner and a number that would show them shrinking, and at least one of them has been written into a checklist, an SOP or a lint rule instead of into a promise.
playbook.scope: Team runs a 45-min retro at sprint close. Inputs are not opinions only — also: AI-aggregated mistake-memory entries since last retro, alert volume, on-call load, PR-cycle time. Outputs are 2-3 concrete experiments for the next sprint, each with an owner.

success-criteria.criterion: All three inputs are on the table before anyone speaks: mistake-memory entries since the last session, incident postmortems together with missed acceptance criteria, and the anonymous feedback
Three patterns are picked to act on over the next two weeks, each carrying a named owner and a signal that would show whether it actually moved
Anything mechanical enough to enforce has landed as a ruff or ESLint rule with a visible diff, instead of an appeal to be more careful next time
At least one behaviour change is live in the SOPs, checklists or tooling, and the team has been told what changed and why it changed

stage.name: Collect Signal

tasks.task: Pull mistake-memory entries since last retro
Pull incident postmortems and missed AC

stage.decision-gate: Advance only when all three sources are gathered.

stage.name: Run the Retro

tasks.task: Walk through what worked, what didn't, surprises
Pick top-3 patterns to act on next 2 weeks

stage.decision-gate: Advance when each pattern has an owner and a measurable signal.

stage.name: Update the System, Not Just the Doc
stage.intent: Memory is only useful if it changes behaviour.

tasks.task: Update SOPs, checklists, or tooling per the patterns
Add or modify ruff/ESLint rules where pattern is mechanical
Communicate the changes to the team

stage.decision-gate: Required output: at least one written behaviour change deployed.
